biotools.summary: The European Genome-phenome Archive (EGA) provides long-term storage and controlled sharing of personally identifiable genetic data. The Rega package offers a streamlined and extensible R interface to the EGA API, facilitating the programmatic upload of metadata. GEO-like Excel submission template is provided as a default method of organizing submission metadata.
